summary: ```markdown # Introduction to Animation Editor Modifications in Marvelous Designer 11 ## Overview of the Animation Editor The animation editor in Marvelous Designer 11 is located at the bottom of the screen. To access the animation editor interface, click the triangle. ## Changes in the Animation Editor Layout In the previous version of Marvelous Designer, some details that were located at the top of the animation editor have now been moved to the right. However, a few commonly used tools remain at the top, including recording, playback, and simulation quality. ## Key Feature: FPS Setting One of the most prominent advantages of the animation editor in Marvelous Designer 11 is the FPS (Frames Per Second) setting. In the previous version, FPS had to be set every time a file was imported. Now, with Marvelous Designer 11, you can set the FPS in the animation settings. To access the animation settings, open the animation settings window, where you will find the frame rate setting at the top. ## Playback Area Configuration In Marvelous Designer 11, only the set playback area can be recorded and played. You can set the playback area by dragging the mouse to the two ends of the yellow bar at the top of the animation layer. Alternatively, you can directly enter the starting and ending frames in the quick menu. ## Simulation Quality Options There are three options for simulation quality: - **Normal**: Typically used to test the animation. - **Animation**: Recommended for final recording. - **Self-defining**: Allows for more complex simulation quality by entering a number greater than 6 in the preset attribute bar on the right. ## Adjusting the Animation Bar You can control the width of the animation bar using the bottom slider: - Click and drag the left slider to the left to widen the area on the left. - Click and drag the right slider to the right to widen the area on the right. - By clicking and dragging the middle part of the slider, you can adjust the entire animation to shift in either direction. You also have the option to enter a number in the input boxes on the left and right sides of the slider to set the viewing area of the animation axis. ## New Pixel Functionality In Marvelous Designer 11, you can utilize the number of pixels, a function that was not available in the previous version. You can input the number in the input box on top of the image. Additionally, you can choose which image to use. When you click and drag, you can adjust the image accordingly. If you click and drag the right slider, you can set the voice and assign a departure position to the lights in the image. ## Character Positioning In the right panel, you can choose to set the character position, allowing for greater flexibility in managing your animation scenes. ```
